mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uib.uid) FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.create_time BETWEEN #{todayStartTime} AND #{todayEndTime} ) AS todayBindings, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uib.uid) FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ) AS periodBindings, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uib.invite_uid) FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ) AS activeInviters, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uib.uid) FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND DATE_SUB(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS retentionEligibleBindings, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uib.uid) FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id JOIN account_login_record alr ON alr.uid = uib.uid AND alr.region_id = uib.region_id AND DATE(alr.create_time) = DATE_ADD(DATE(uib.create_time), INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE uib.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND DATE_SUB(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS retainedUsers

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(uib.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(DISTINCT uib.uid) AS bindings FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(uib.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate

WITH invite_base AS ( SELECT uib.region_id, uib.invite_uid, uib.uid, uib.create_time AS bind_time, NULLIF(a.device_id, '') AS device_id FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
), base_stat AS ( SELECT region_id, invite_uid, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS bound_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bind_time <= DATE_SUB(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN uid ELSE NULL END) AS retention_eligible_users FROM invite_base GROUP BY region_id, invite_uid ), retention_stat AS ( SELECT ib.region_id, ib.invite_uid, COUNT(DISTINCT ib.uid) AS retained_users FROM invite_base ib JOIN account_login_record alr ON alr.uid = ib.uid AND alr.region_id = ib.region_id AND DATE(alr.create_time) = DATE_ADD(DATE(ib.bind_time), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY ib.region_id, ib.invite_uid ), charge_by_user AS ( SELECT ib.region_id, ib.invite_uid, ib.uid, SUM(cr.amount_usd) AS user_gmv FROM invite_base ib JOIN charge_record cr ON cr.uid = ib.uid AND cr.region_id = ib.region_id AND cr.create_time >= ib.bind_time AND cr.create_time <= #{endTime} WHERE cr.charge_status = 2 AND cr.channel NOT IN ('REDPACKET_GET_PAY', 'PROXY_PAY') GROUP BY ib.region_id, ib.invite_uid, ib.uid ), charge_stat AS ( SELECT region_id, invite_uid, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS pay_users, IFNULL(SUM(user_gmv), 0) AS gmv FROM charge_by_user GROUP BY region_id, invite_uid ), device_groups AS ( SELECT region_id, invite_uid, device_id, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS device_users FROM invite_base WHERE device_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region_id, invite_uid, device_id ), device_stat AS ( SELECT region_id, invite_uid, IFNULL(MAX(device_users), 0) AS max_device_cluster FROM device_groups GROUP BY region_id, invite_uid ) SELECT bs.invite_uid AS inviterUid, bs.bound_users AS boundUsers, ROUND(IFNULL(rs.retained_users, 0) * 100 / NULLIF(bs.retention_eligible_users, 0), 2) AS d1Retention, ROUND(IFNULL(cs.pay_users, 0) * 100 / bs.bound_users, 2) AS payRate, IFNULL(cs.gmv, 0) AS gmv, IFNULL(ds.max_device_cluster, 0) AS maxDeviceCluster FROM base_stat bs LEFT JOIN retention_stat rs ON rs.invite_uid = bs.invite_uid AND rs.region_id = bs.region_id LEFT JOIN charge_stat cs ON cs.invite_uid = bs.invite_uid AND cs.region_id = bs.region_id LEFT JOIN device_stat ds ON ds.invite_uid = bs.invite_uid AND ds.region_id = bs.region_id ORDER BY bs.bound_users DESC, gmv DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.country FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.region_id = #{regionId} AND a.country IS NOT NULL AND a.country != '' ORDER BY a.country

SELECT DISTINCT a.channel FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.region_id = #{regionId} AND a.channel IS NOT NULL AND a.channel != '' ORDER BY a.channel
SELECT DISTINCT a.os FROM user_invite_bind uib JOIN account a ON a.uid = uib.uid AND a.region_id = uib.region_id WHERE uib.region_id = #{regionId} AND a.os IS NOT NULL AND a.os != '' ORDER BY a.os
